basic_profile.bio: I am a 36-year-old music enthusiast and part-time DJ based in Cape Town, South Africa. I have a passion for electronic music, particularly house and techno, and have been exploring the art of DJing for over a decade. When I'm not spinning tracks, I work as a data engineer for a fintech company, which keeps me engaged with the latest in technology and data trends. My interests include music production, digital audio technology, and occasionally dabbling in graphic design. I enjoy discussing music gear and sharing insights with fellow DJs. I'm usually online in the evenings after work and on weekends. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time at local music events or exploring the vibrant culture of my city.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in computer science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My technical skills in data engineering are complemented by a deep knowledge of music technology, which I have acquired through self-learning and hands-on experience in DJing. My interest in DJ equipment and music production has led me to stay updated on the latest trends and innovations in the field.
